row.evidence: ADP Workforce Now's packages (Select, Plus, Premium) are quote-only ('Get pricing'); ADP documents Federated SSO over SAML 2.0 and an API Central that pushes worker data out for 'automating user provisioning to your systems', but no SCIM endpoint into ADP.
row.notes: New row. ADP is a suite; this row covers ADP Workforce Now (mid-market HCM), with Vantage HCM, Lyric, RUN and others noted but not split. ADP is an HR system of record: its own users are employees created from HR records, and every identity integration found pushes data out of ADP (API Central 'automating user provisioning to your systems'; Aquera's Identity Directory Sync Bridge; Okta's ADP Workforce Now HR-as-a-Master connector by Aquera, which imports from ADP into Okta), so under rule 3a status is none (by absence, confidence low because adp.com and the help centre block or require login). SSO is ADP Federated Single Sign-On (SAML 2.0; Entra gallery apps ADP and ADP (OIDC); Okta lists only SWA ADP apps), arranged through ADP ('Contact us'). API Central is a separately priced Marketplace product ('Login to see prices'), so api_tax is true; ADP's API reference sits in a JS-only developer portal that could not be read. Prices are not public for any package.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Adds time and attendance. scim=false reflects no inbound SCIM documented for any package (by absence).

scim.notes: No inbound SCIM endpoint found (rule 3a): ADP's identity integrations all treat ADP as the source and push worker data to IdPs and directories.

limitations.text: API Central pricing is only visible after login to ADP Marketplace.

user_api.notes: API Central gives access to ADP's HR APIs (workers, payroll); the developer portal is a JS app whose API reference could not be read, so endpoints and auth are not recorded.

okta.notes: OIN has many ADP apps, all SWA (password vaulting) except Aquera connectors; 'ADP Workforce Now by Aquera' is HR-as-a-master (imports from ADP into Okta), not provisioning into ADP.

entra.notes: Gallery apps 'ADP' (SAML) and 'ADP (OIDC)'; tutorials cover SSO only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: ADP API Central and Marketplace connectors (e.g. Aquera Identity Directory Sync Bridge) push worker data from ADP to IdPs and directories
fallbacks.notes: Federated SSO is SAML 2.0 and set up with ADP's help; whether it can create ADP users on first sign-in is not documented.
